text_to_image_prompt:
Use case: spatial production design. Scene: 多题材场景60组 · 16 · 旋梯环绕的法术图书馆.
Environment:  A luminous original magic academy library with two levels of curved warm-oak shelves, a graceful wrought-brass spiral staircase, a few small books gently hovering above an empty reading table, cream stone walls and generous high windows. No readable writing or portraits, no people or animals. Quiet scholarly magical realism, open center floor, lived-in crafted materials.
Visual medium: realistic live action; keep the scene's stated palette, light and tactile materials.
Required image format: ONE independent orthographic architectural elevation or cut section of the principal facade / interior wall. Show openings, vertical structure, floor levels, stair and roof relationships where visible. Readable architectural profile with restrained white margin and a short elevation title.
A coherent environment-only concept reconstruction for story staging. No people, characters, animals, humanoid statues, faces, silhouettes or human reflections. Legible spatial proportions and usable paths. Not surveyed construction documentation.
original_prompt: Reconstruct the SAME scene from reference 1 concept plan, reference 2 original look. Match plan footprint, fixed window/door/stair/furniture positions. Scene: 多题材场景60组 · 16 · 旋梯环绕的法术图书馆. One flat architectural orthographic main facade elevation or interior principal wall elevation. Show openings, structural bays, vertical proportions, ceiling profile and material detail. No perspective montage, no furniture moved against the elevation. White page, title INTERIOR ELEVATION or FRONT ELEVATION. Preserve reference materials, light and style. Unseen extension conservative. Empty environment, NO people, animals, silhouettes, statues of humans, no unrelated spaces. Landscape image, no dimensions.
